coordinate_rule: Break1_loc and Break2_loc are compared as zero-based interbase positions against original plan endpoint windows [start, end); merged window bounds are not used.
interpretation_limits: Native Pass, Foldback, and Chimeric labels are not biological truth.
Eligible means observed records passed collector SA consistency checks; it does not prove all molecule placements or validate an allele.
UNKNOWN is not a negative result.
Foldback and Chimeric QNAME sets are any-breakpoint labels and can overlap; native final read-level dominance is not computed.
Endpoint overlap is geometric context, not artifact or inversion support.
No thresholds, sensitivity estimates, or genotype inferences are computed.
